affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for active-mobility network project portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for active-mobility network project portfolio
pair connectivity, safety, equity, and lifecycle project optimization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, counts, facilities, stress levels, barriers, and shared-vehicle states use documented coverage.
Observed shared-system trips do not represent all walking and cycling demand.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for active-mobility network project portfolio.

constraints.description: The active mobility network and micromobility prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
decision_question: Which protected links, crossings, greenways, and accessibility repairs close the most consequential gaps?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The active mobility network and micromobility prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for active-mobility network project portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: connectivity, safety, equity, and lifecycle project optimization
independence_key.primary_outcome: essential trips remaining outside a low-stress accessible network

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting active-mobility network project portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: essential trips remaining outside a low-stress accessible network
distributional gap in essential trips remaining outside a low-stress accessible network
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled connectivity or safety gains as completed trips or prevented crashes.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for active-mobility network project portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize active-mobility network projects
transportability_risks: Topography, climate, street stress, vehicle access, pricing, and safety perceptions vary.
Platform data can exclude private bicycles, pedestrians, and non-users.
